design.source_policy: same limited metadata derivation, exclude 244 prior source hashes and paths, 36 new source copy examples and 64 separate new crystals; exact-byte and quarantine controls retained
design.curriculum: one-symbol/one-digit/short relations first; level 1 two-character tasks; level 2 longer tasks; 60 trials each cumulative levels, uniform control and first-byte control
design.generation: greedy all 258 tokens, no length oracle, max 7 generated tokens, exact answer followed by newline required; early EOS is not counted as newline
design.preservation: old paired and open masks plus 16 actual parent-correct historical next-byte witnesses at every step; separate 16 from historical retain_eval at final exam; fail closed if not enough
design.exam: each primitive family >=50% exact terminated and >= parent, zero old pair/open/historical losses; separately preserve R1.15 relation gate >=20/32 both formulations with gain >=4
design.trinity: local deterministic alternate veto predicate; no external teacher claim
design.akinator: parent deficit ranking per family, fixed curriculum rather than autonomous material choice

limits: Historical witness documents are historical train-labelled, not external blind; may be familiar to parent; cross-document duplicate semantics possible
Synthetic primitive tasks use new prompt instances but input and target values may recur; source-copy tasks are derived numeric metadata, not scientific facts
Source copy training prompts also appear in old replay; gate/exam source-copy prompts also in corresponding retention cohorts; all three source cohorts disjoint
Same relation source identities during training and final wording test; not unseen-source reasoning
Equal padded model positions, different supervised target counts; no wall-time equality
TRINITY checks are local deterministic predicates; AKINATOR diagnostic does not independently choose curriculum
No production change, promotion or candidate export; no external blind exam or network isolation proof
